---
title: "`r local({ cfg <- params$config; pname <- cfg$project$name %||% ''; analyst <- gsub('_', ' ', cfg$project$analyst %||% ''); parts <- c('Lipidomics QC Report'); if (nzchar(pname)) parts <- c(parts, pname); if (nzchar(analyst)) parts <- c(parts, analyst); paste(parts, collapse = ' - ') })`"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d')`"
author: "`r paste0('Bioinformatician: ', gsub('_', ' ', params$config$project$analyst %||% ''))`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    toc_float: true
    self_contained: true
    theme: cosmo
params:
  pre: NULL
  qc_res: NULL
  qc_enhanced: NULL
  config: NULL
  out_dir: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b
pre <- params$pre
out_dir <- params$out_dir
diag_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "Diagnostic_plots")
ds_dir   <- file.path(out_dir, "Datasets")

show_img <- function(fname, caption = NULL) {
  p <- file.path(diag_dir, fname)
  if (file.exists(p)) knitr::include_graphics(p) else cat("_", fname, " not found_\n", sep = "")
}
```

# Run summary

```{r summary}
info <- pre$info %||% list()
miss <- info$missingness %||% list()
tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c("Features (raw)", "Features (filtered)", "Samples",
             "Lipid classes", "Missing cells (%)",
             "Sample normalization", "Transformation", "Scaling"),
  Value = c(info$n_features_raw %||% NA, info$n_features_filt %||% NA,
            info$n_samples %||% NA, info$n_lipid_classes %||% NA,
            miss$pct_missing %||% NA,
            info$normalization$sample_norm %||% "none",
            info$normalization$transform %||% "none",
            info$normalization$scaling %||% "none")
) |> knitr::kable()
```

# Normalization method comparison

```{r norm-comp}
comp_path <- file.path(ds_dir, "normalization_method_comparison.tsv")
if (file.exists(comp_path)) {
  comp_df <- utils::read.table(comp_path, header = TRUE, sep = "\t",
                               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  knitr::kable(comp_df,
               caption = "Median RSD computed on the pre-scaling matrix (auto/pareto would otherwise inflate RSD because feature means → 0). PC1 variance computed on the full pipeline output.")
} else {
  cat("_No normalization comparison TSV found — `evaluate_methods` block in config is empty._")
}
```

# Missingness

```{r missingness}
miss <- pre$info$missingness
if (!is.null(miss)) {
  per_sample <- miss$per_sample
  if (length(per_sample)) {
    df <- data.frame(sample = names(per_sample),
                     pct_missing = round(100 * per_sample, 2),
                     row.names = NULL)
    df <- df[order(-df$pct_missing), , drop = FALSE]
    knitr::kable(utils::head(df, 20),
                 caption = "Top 20 samples by missingness (%).")
  }
}
```

# PERMANOVA

```{r permanova}
perm <- params$qc_enhanced$permanova
if (is.null(perm) || (is.list(perm) && length(perm) == 0)) {
  cat("_PERMANOVA result not available (vegan missing, or skipped)._")
} else if (is.data.frame(perm)) {
  knitr::kable(perm, caption = "PERMANOVA on full distance matrix.")
} else {
  print(perm)
}
```
